incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A wide street is flooded with brown water, submerging the lower levels of multi-story buildings. The scene appears to be an urban area with historic architecture under overcast conditions.

observations.description: Brown, murky water covering the street and reaching up to the ground floors of buildings.
Multi-story buildings with varied facades, some with balconies and arched doorways, partially submerged in flood water.
No vehicles visible in the flooded area.
A stop sign and a blue arrow directional sign are visible on the right side of the image.
